objectives: By the end of the week, students will build our classroom community, learn the routines and materials needed for math class, set up DeltaMath, and demonstrate what they remember from Grade 5 math.
agenda: Tuesday: Welcome to 6th Grade Math; make name tents; meet our class; review daily materials; receive an available take-home IM book; and begin the Grade 5 math diagnostic.
Wednesday: Complete the Grade 5 math diagnostic and register for DeltaMath.
Thursday: Practice our classroom routines and begin our first math lesson.
Friday: Continue the math lesson, share strategies, and reflect on our first week.
Name-Tent Directions: Fold an 8.5 × 11-inch sheet into thirds so it stands. Write your name large, dark, and easy to read. At the bottom, add one sport or activity you enjoy.
Daily Materials: Bring a notebook, paper, and a pencil to every class.
homework: Bring your notebook, paper, and a pencil every day. Keep your assigned math book at home for review.
languageObjectives: Students will introduce themselves and share one sport or activity they enjoy.
Students will explain their mathematical thinking and describe the strategies they use.
